_comment: All tunable numbers. Code reads them through GameData.bal("section.key").

world._interact_stack: #35: things whose aim points lie this close to the chosen one share the spot; the player switches between them

biomes._comment: #70: floors 1..fixed_floors keep the fixed biome order; later cycles of five are seeded shuffles (no biome twice in a row). From mixed_from_floor, mixed_share of floors are mixed: monster_share of the spawn weight comes from an invader picked from pairs[biome], and with hazard_chance one of the invader's hazards joins.

boons._comment: #73: after every boss each hero is offered three boons (data/boons/*.json), one of each kind when it can. Weight: rarity_weights[rarity - 1] x (1 + tag_weight x tags shared with the hero's boons); with fresh_chance the third card favours tags the hero hasn't got. unique_per_level: a unique boon item's own stats grow by this share per item level. choose_delay: s after the boss before the cards open. hud_icons: boon icons shown beside the portrait.

ghost._comment: #82: a ghost roams the floor until the next one. Light radius = lighting.carried_torch_radius x light_radius_mult; it counts only for the ghost's own sight. Alphas: the ghost's own view / the living's view.

lighting._comment: Darkness is a mechanic: monsters are only visible while lit. Radii are lit areas in px.
lighting._comment_hero_light: #80: with the lobby setting Torches off, every hero gives this steady light instead (radius = carried_torch_radius x hero_light_radius_mult).

loot._rarity_comment: #65: drop rarity weights (Common..Relic) move linearly from rarity_weights on floor 1 to rarity_weights_deep on floor rarity_deep_depth and stay there; the Relic weight is the same at every depth.
loot._flight_comment: #75: loot flies out of its source: time + time_per_px x distance, from from_height px above the source, arc_height px high, spins turns, one bounce; items in one drop follow each other by stagger s.
loot._event_sources: #72: the events' rewards, rolled like a chest: drops = item count, min_rarity = the lowest rarity; gold ranges in gold.<source>.

gold._comment: Gold piles (D12): amount ranges per source, x (1 + per_level x (item level - 1)). A pile is split among living party members.

elite._comment: Elite packs (D10) and the Gold Key (D11).

merchant._comment: Item value = tier_value[rarity - 1] x (1 + per_item_level x (item level - 1)); Archibald sells at buy_mult and buys at sell_mult (#24: buying costs 3x the old price, selling unchanged).

level_scale._comment: Level-30 numbers (legendaries D7, pacts D15) scale by floor + (1 - floor) x level / 30.

lore._comment: Lore books (GDD 7, D20): category roll first, then a book of that category from the floor's biome (+ Ancient Lore anywhere). Unread books weigh x unread_weight.

dungeon._comment: #58: deeper floors are a little bigger: room count (and grid area, to keep the density) +2.5% per floor below the first, at most 1.5x (depth 21 on).

save._comment: #55: the host writes the saved game (heroes and the floor) this often, and clients send their discovered map this often when it changed.

performance._comment: #56: frame cap while the window is out of focus (V-Sync off then, so the host keeps simulating at full rate).

camera._comment_view: The visible world is capped so ultrawide screens zoom in instead of showing past the dungeon; narrow screens keep at least min_view_* world px.

ui._comment: HUD/menu layout and feel. Sizes are in base-viewport px (960x540 minimum).

splash._comment: Boot splash over the title screen (seconds). Any key/button skips it.

legendary._drop_comment: #65: named legendaries stay rare at every depth (no depth scaling); bosses are the generous source.

combat._friendly_target: #39: a picked teammate stays picked within this distance; a click this close to a teammate's body picks them
combat._immunity: A monster 'immune' to a damage type (data immune, statuses immune_<type>) takes this much less of it instead of none (#22).

probe._comment: Pacing bands for tests/balance_suite.gd (scenario balance): one hero of level = depth in rare gear, primary attack only, monster behaviour modules off. Seconds.
probe._mods_comment: #71 floor cost probe (BalanceSuite.floor_cost / run_mods): a modded floor's effort (fight time and damage) relative to the plain floor must sit inside mod_cost_band, around what one floor deeper costs the same party (measured x1.02-x1.21), and its reward (gold + gold-valued items + xp/4) must reach mod_reward_min x its cost. Assumptions the layout can't show: the share of fight time a hero stands still on Restless, the darkness's extra damage on Dimmed, the travel time that brings Hunted's hunters.
